replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged immutable mission revision provenance change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in immutable mission revision provenance; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: No rules bump or checkpoint drop slot is introduced: existing once/unknown/no-drop-slot retention preserves the durable mission.provenance sidecar.

compatibility.detail: Optional mission provenance is a durable mission.provenance sidecar, outside MissionSpec, so existing revision hashes stay unchanged. Older nodes retain the unknown sidecar and run the ordinary mission but cannot apply provenance-bearing KDL and show no provenance. Publish new provenance through an upgraded member; existing client read objects accept the additive fields.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by immutable mission revision provenance; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: Provenance can be attached only at first publication of a mission revision. An already published revision cannot be retroactively annotated or have its provenance changed; publish a new definition revision. Existing missions require no conversion.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
